name: bark-recon
description: Reverse-engineered building blocks for Bark: Solana on-chain decoders, launchpad curve math, venue adapters and market-intelligence primitives.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/solana packages/pumpfun packages/market-intel packages/venues packages/cli
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/solana packages/pumpfun packages/market-intel packages/venues packages/cli
scripts.test: node --test packages/solana/dist/test/*.test.js packages/pumpfun/dist/test/*.test.js packages/market-intel/dist/test/*.test.js packages/venues/dist/test/*.test.js packages/cli/dist/test/*.test.js
